name: How much does a hit-and-run accident attorney cost?
description: Most hit-and-run attorneys work on a contingency fee basis, meaning you pay no upfront costs, and they only get paid if they win your case.

mainEntity.name: How much does a hit-and-run accident attorney cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most personal injury attorneys, including those specializing in hit-and-run cases, work on a contingency fee basis. This means you do not pay any upfront legal fees. Instead, the attorney's fees are a percentage of the compensation they secure for you, whether through a settlement or a court award. If your attorney does not recover compensation for you, you typically do not owe attorney fees. This arrangement allows individuals to pursue justice without immediate financial burden.
